finding: Shopify Admin GraphQL API 2026-10 exposes structured return policy profiles that can be associated with markets. A direct Market.returnPolicyProfile null does not resolve hierarchy; nullable returnRules/editRules mean those rules are turned off.
old_approach: Generic store-wide refund-policy text could be mistaken for the target market's applicable return terms.
new_rule: MARKET_RETURN_POLICY_GATE: use authorized market-specific structured return rules as policy/trust context only; never substitute policy terms for observed returned_quantity, return reasons, sales_reversals, margin, or demand.
test_metric: On authorized target-market read, capture applicable return window/rules alongside physical return metrics; no causal claim.
failure_fallback: If authorized market/profile data or hierarchy resolution is unavailable, mark MARKET_RETURN_POLICY_UNVERIFIED and do not invent a return window.
